title: MSstatsPTM LabelFree Workflow
text: install package, start R (version “4.0”) enter:
code: if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))     install.packages("BiocManager")  BiocManager::install("MSstatsPTM") library(MSstatsPTM) library(MSstats)

title: MSstatsPTM LabelFree Workflow
text: Note: actively developing dedicated converters MSstatsPTM. data processing tool dedicated converter MSstatsPTM please add github issue https://github.com/Vitek-Lab/MSstatsPTM/issues add converter. first step load raw dataset PTM Protein datasets. dataset can formatted using dedicated converters MSstatsPTM, FragePipetoMSstatsPTMFormat. dedicated converter tool MSstatsPTM, can alternatively leverage converters base MSstats. using converters MSstats note need run global protein PTM datasets. Please note PTM dataset, protein modification site (peptide), must added ProteinName column. allows package summarize peptide level, avoid chance matching peptides proteins. example can done please see code . output converter list two formatted data.tables. One PTM Protein datasets. global profiling run performed, Protein data.table just NULL

title: MSstatsPTM LabelFree Workflow
text: MSstatsPTM includes dedicated converter MaxQuant output. Experiments can acquired label-free TMT labeling methods. matter experiment, recommend using evidence.txt file, PTM specific file Phospho (STY).txt file. MaxQtoMSstatsPTMFormat converter includes variety parameters. Examples processing TMT LF dataset can seen .

text: might notice FASTA file also needed converters. FASTA file can obtained querying Uniprot protein IDs present PTM dataset. Follow steps download FASTA file UniProt: Prepare protein IDs Make list protein IDs (e.g., UniProt accessions like P31749, Q9Y243, etc.). can copy-paste UniProt tool. Go UniProt ID mapping tool Open UniProt ID mapping page: https://www.uniprot.org/id-mapping Select input database “” dropdown, choose: UniProtKB AC/ID isoform-specific data needed, select: UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot Otherwise, select: UniProtKB Submit IDs Paste protein IDs text box click “Submit”. Click “Download” button top table. Select “FASTA (canonical)” click download FASTA file necessary input tools (e.g. MaxQuant) report specific amino acid modified relative whole protein sequence. Rather, report specific amino acid relative reported peptide. distinction important modifications like phosphorylation, methylation, acetylation often specific roles depending occur within full-length protein. help FASTA file, MSstatsPTM can determine specific amino acid modified context whole protein sequence.

title: MSstatsPTM LabelFree Workflow
text: dedicated MSstatsPTM converter processing tool, existing converters MSstats MSstatsTMT converters can used described . Note, order , critical ProteinName column combination Protein Name modification site. example, like analyze experiment processed DIANN, can leverage DIANNtoMSstatsFormat MSstats. Given two datasets, named raw_ptm_df raw_protein_df, annotation file, can process data follows. variable msstatsptm_input_data can now used input remainder MSstatsPTM processing pipeline.
code: # Add site into ProteinName column raw_ptm_df$ProteinName = paste(raw_ptm_df$ProteinName,                                 raw_ptm_df$Site, sep = "_")  # Run MSstats Converters PTM_data = MSstats::DIANNtoMSstatsFormat(raw_ptm_df, annotation) PROTEIN_data = MSstats::DIANNtoMSstatsFormat(raw_protein_df, annotation)  # Combine into one list msstatsptm_input_data = list(PTM = PTM_data, PROTEIN = PROTEIN_data)

title: MSstatsPTM TMT Workflow
text: show profile plot. top plot shows modified peptide, bottom shows overall protein.
code: dataProcessPlotsPTM(MSstatsPTM.summary,                     type = 'PROFILEPLOT',                     which.Protein = c("Protein_12"),                     address = FALSE)

title: MSstatsPTM TMT Workflow
text: summarization, summarized datasets can modeled using groupComparisonPTM function. function model PTM Protein summarized datasets, adjust PTM model changes overall protein abundance. output function list containing three models named: PTM.Model, PROTEIN.Model, ADJUSTED.Model.

title: Statistical Characterization of Post-translational Modifications
text: MSstatsPTM provides general statistical methods quantitative characterization post-translational modifications (PTMs). Supports DDA, DIA, tandem mass tag (TMT) labeling. Typically, analysis involves quantification PTM sites (.e., modified residues) corresponding proteins, well integration quantification results. MSstatsPTM provides functions summarization, estimation PTM site abundance, detection changes PTMs across experimental conditions.

title: Convert the output of DIA-NN PSM file into MSstatsPTM format — DIANNtoMSstatsPTMFormat
text: Takes input report.tsv file DIA-NN converts MSstatsPTM format. Requires PSM annotation file. Optionally additional report.tsv file corresponding global profiling run can included.

title: Convert the output of DIA-NN PSM file into MSstatsPTM format — DIANNtoMSstatsPTMFormat
code: DIANNtoMSstatsPTMFormat(   input,   annotation,   input_protein = NULL,   annotation_protein = NULL,   fasta_path = NULL,   use_unmod_peptides = FALSE,   protein_id_col = "Protein.Group",   fasta_protein_name = "uniprot_ac",   global_qvalue_cutoff = 0.01,   qvalue_cutoff = 0.01,   pg_qvalue_cutoff = 0.01,   useUniquePeptide = TRUE,   removeFewMeasurements = TRUE,   removeOxidationMpeptides = TRUE,   removeProtein_with1Feature = FALSE,   MBR = TRUE,   quantificationColumn = "FragmentQuantCorrected",   use_log_file = TRUE,   append = FALSE,   verbose = TRUE,   log_file_path = NULL )

title: Convert the output of DIA-NN PSM file into MSstatsPTM format — DIANNtoMSstatsPTMFormat
text: input name MSstats input report Diann, includes fragment-level data. Output fragment data –export-quant flag DIA-NN 2.0 annotation name 'annotation.txt' data includes Condition, BioReplicate, Run. input_protein input global profiling run. Default NULL. annotation_protein annotation global profiling run. Default NULL. fasta_path string path FASTA file, used match PTM peptides. use_unmod_peptides Boolean unmodified peptides input file used construct unmodified protein output. used input_protein provided. Default FALSE. protein_id_col Use 'Protein.Groups'(default) column protein name. fasta_protein_name Name column matches protein names protein_id_col. protein names two columns must match order join FASTA file DIA-NN output. Default "uniprot_ac" uniprot ID. uniprot mnemonic ID, use "entry_name" global_qvalue_cutoff qvalue cutoff Q.Value column, .e. run-specific precursor q-value. Default 0.01. qvalue_cutoff MBR false, qvalue cutoff Global.Q.Value column, .e. global precursor q-value.  MBR true, qvalue cutoff Lib.Q.Value column, .e. q-value library created first MBR pass. Default 0.01. pg_qvalue_cutoff MBR false, qvalue cutoff Global.PG.Q.Value column, .e. global q-value protein group.  MBR true, qvalue cutoff Lib.PG.Q.Value column, .e. protein group q-value library created first MBR pass. Default 0.01. useUniquePeptide unique peptides removed removeFewMeasurements proteins measurements removed removeOxidationMpeptides peptides oxidation removed removeProtein_with1Feature proteins single feature removed MBR True analysis done match runs quantificationColumn Use 'FragmentQuantCorrected'(default) column quantified intensities DIANN 1.8.x. Use 'FragmentQuantRaw' quantified intensities DIANN 1.9.x. Use 'auto' quantified intensities DIANN 2.x fragment intensity separate column, e.g. Fr0Quantity. use_log_file logical. TRUE, information data processing saved file. append logical. TRUE, information data processing added existing log file. verbose logical. TRUE, information data processing wil printed console. log_file_path character. Path file information data processing saved. provided, file created automatically. append = TRUE, valid path file.

what: Convert output of TMT labeled Fragpipe data into MSstatsPTM format. — FragPipetoMSstatsPTMFormat
title: Convert output of TMT labeled Fragpipe data into MSstatsPTM format. — FragPipetoMSstatsPTMFormat
text: Takes input TMT experiments output Fragpipe converts MSstatsPTM format. Requires msstats.csv file annotation file. Optionally additional msstats.csv file can uploaded corresponding global profiling run performed. Site localization performed high probability localizations kept.

title: Convert output of TMT labeled Fragpipe data into MSstatsPTM format. — FragPipetoMSstatsPTMFormat
code: FragPipetoMSstatsPTMFormat(   input,   annotation = NULL,   input_protein = NULL,   annotation_protein = NULL,   use_unmod_peptides = FALSE,   label_type = "TMT",   protein_id_col = "Protein",   peptide_id_col = "Peptide.Sequence",   mod_id_col = "STY",   localization_cutoff = 0.75,   remove_unlocalized_peptides = TRUE,   Purity_cutoff = 0.6,   PeptideProphet_prob_cutoff = 0.7,   useUniquePeptide = TRUE,   rmPSM_withfewMea_withinRun = FALSE,   rmPeptide_OxidationM = TRUE,   rmProtein_with1Feature = FALSE,   summaryforMultipleRows = sum,   use_log_file = TRUE,   append = FALSE,   verbose = TRUE,   log_file_path = NULL )

Refer example 'annotation' meaning column. Channel column consistent channel columns (Ignore prefix "Channel ") msstats.csv file. Run column consistent Spectrum.File columns msstats.csv file. input_protein input global profiling run. Default NULL. annotation_protein annotation global profiling run. Default NULL. use_unmod_peptides Boolean unmodified peptides input file used construct unmodified protein output. used input_protein provided. Default FALSE. label_type Type labeling used experiment. Must one "LF" "TMT". Default "TMT". protein_id_col Use 'Protein'(default) column TMT. needs changed "ProteinName" label free. TMT, 'Master.Protein.Accessions' can used instead get protein ID single protein. peptide_id_col Use 'Peptide.Sequence'(default) column TMT. Must changed "PeptideSequence" label free. "Modified.Peptide.Sequence" can used instead get modified peptide sequence. mod_id_col Column containing modified Amino Acids. example, Phosphorylation experiment may pass STY. corresponding column STY combined mass (e.x. STY.79.9663) selected. Default STY. localization_cutoff Minimum localization score required keep modification. Default .75. remove_unlocalized_peptides Boolean indicating peptides without sites localized kept. Default TRUE (non-localized sites removed). Purity_cutoff Cutoff purity. Default 0.6. Purity refers much detected ion signal within specific inclusion window belongs target molecule closely related forms, compared unwanted signals noise. Higher values indicate greater purity. PeptideProphet_prob_cutoff Cutoff peptide identification probability. Default 0.7. probability confidence score determined PeptideProphet higher values indicate greater confidence. useUniquePeptide logical, TRUE (default) removes peptides assigned one proteins. assume use unique peptide protein. rmPSM_withfewMea_withinRun TRUE remove features 1 2 measurements within Run. Default FALSE. rmPeptide_OxidationM TRUE (default) remove peptides including oxidation (M) sequence. rmProtein_with1Feature TRUE remove proteins 1 peptide charge. Default FALSE. summaryforMultipleRows sum (default) max - multiple measurements certain feature certain run, select feature largest summation maximal value. use_log_file logical. TRUE, information data processing saved file. append logical. TRUE, information data processing added existing log file. verbose logical. TRUE, information data processing wil printed console. log_file_path character. Path file information data processing saved. provided, file created automatically. 'append = TRUE', valid path file.

what: MSstatsPTM: A package for detecting differentially abundant post-translational modifications (PTM) in mass spectrometry-based proteomic experiments. — MSstatsPTM
title: MSstatsPTM: A package for detecting differentially abundant post-translational modifications (PTM) in mass spectrometry-based proteomic experiments. — MSstatsPTM
text: set tools detecting differentially abundant PTMs proteins shotgun mass spectrometry-based proteomic experiments. package can handle variety acquisition types, including label free TMT experiments, acquired DDA, DIA, SRM PRM acquisition methods. package includes tools convert raw data different spectral processing tools, summarize feature intensities, fit linear mixed effects model. major advantage package leverage separate global profiling run adjust PTM fold change changes unmodified protein, showing unconvoluted PTM fold change. Finally, package includes functionality plot variety data visualizations.

title: Convert output of label-free or TMT MaxQuant experiments into MSstatsPTM format — MaxQtoMSstatsPTMFormat
text: evidence name 'evidence.txt' data, includes feature-level data enriched (PTM) data. annotation data frame annotation file ptm level data. Contains column Run, Fraction, TechRepMixture, Mixture, Channel, BioReplicate, Condition. fasta_path string path FASTA file, used match PTM peptides. fasta_protein_name Name fasta column matches protein name evidence file. Default uniprot_ac. mod_id Character indicates modification interest. Default \\(Phospho\\). Note \\ must included special characters. sites_data (recommended. used evidence file provided. works TMT labeled data) Modified peptide output MaxQuant. example, phosphorylation experiment require Phospho(STY)Sites.txt file evidence_prot name 'evidence.txt' data, includes feature-level data global profiling (unmodified) data. proteinGroups name 'proteinGroups.txt' data. needs matching protein group ID evidence_prot. annotation_protein data frame annotation file protein level data. Contains column Run, Fraction, TechRepMixture, Mixture, Channel, BioReplicate, Condition. use_unmod_peptides Boolean unmodified peptides input file used construct unmodified protein output. used input_protein provided. Default FALSE. labeling_type Either TMT LF (Label-Free) depending experimental design. Default LF. mod_num (sites.data used) modified peptide dataset. number modifications per peptide used. "Single", peptides one modification used. Otherwise "Total" can selected cap number modifications per peptide. "Single" default. Selecting "Total" may confound effect different modifications. TMT_keyword (sites.data used) sub-name columns sites.data file. Default TMT. corresponds columns format Reporter.intensity.corrected.1.TMT1phos___1. Specifically, parameter indicates first section string TMT1phos (mixture number). TMT present string, set value TMT. Else TMT (ie string format 1phos) leave parameter empty string (”). ptm_keyword (sites.data used) sub-name columns sites.data file. Default phos. corresponds columns format Reporter.intensity.corrected.1.TMT1phos___1. Specifically, parameter indicates second section string TMT1phos (mixture number). string present, set parameter. Else part string empty (ie string format TMT1) leave parameter empty string (”). which_proteinid_ptm PTM dataset, column use protein name. Use 'Proteins'(default) column protein name. 'Leading.proteins' 'Leading.razor.protein' 'Gene.names' can used instead get protein ID single protein. However, can potentially shared peptides. which_proteinid_protein Protein dataset, column use protein name. options . remove_other_mods Remove peptides include modfications one listed mod_id. Default TRUE. example, experiment targeting Phosphorylation, setting parameter TRUE remove peptides like (Acetyl (Protein N-term))AAAAPDSRVS(Phospho (STY))EEENLK. Set parameter FALSE keep peptides extraneous modifications. removeMpeptides Oxidation (M) modifications removed. Default TRUE. removeOxidationMpeptides TRUE remove peptides including 'oxidation (M)' modification. FALSE default. removeProtein_with1Peptide TRUE remove proteins 1 peptide charge. FALSE default. use_log_file logical. TRUE, information data processing saved file. append logical. TRUE, information data processing added existing log file. verbose logical. TRUE, information data processing wil printed console. log_file_path character. Path file information data processing saved. provided, file created automatically. 'append = TRUE', valid path file.

title: Convert Peaks Studio output into MSstatsPTM format — PStoMSstatsPTMFormat
text: input name Peaks Studio PTM output annotation name annotation file includes Raw.file, Condition, BioReplicate, Run. example annotation see example . input_protein name Peaks Studio unmodified protein output (optional) annotation_protein name annotation file includes Raw.file, Condition, BioReplicate, Run unmodified protein output. use_unmod_peptides Boolean unmodified peptides input file used construct unmodified protein output. used input_protein provided. Default FALSE target_modification Character name modification interest. use mod types, leave NULL. Default NULL. Note name includes special characters, must include "\" characters. Ex. "Phosphorylation \(STY\)" remove_oxidation_peptides Boolean Oxidation (M) modifications removed. Default FALSE remove_multi_mod_types Used target_modification NULL. TRUE remove peptides multiple types modifications (ie acetylation phosphorylation). FALSE keep peptides summarize seperately. summaryforMultipleRows max(default) sum - multiple measurements certain feature certain run, use highest sum multiple intensities. use_log_file logical. TRUE, information data processing saved file. append logical. TRUE, information data processing added existing log file. verbose logical. TRUE, information data processing wil printed console. log_file_path character. Path file information data processing saved. provided, file created automatically. 'append = TRUE', valid path file.
